title: Conversation-aware ads gain images
summary:
Ads gained contextual images and sharper copy, while the project directory made more room for vibe coding and community creations.

Ads triggered by `p-ads` can now include a generated 120×120 image. Ad copy draws on the last three messages and the current content, making it more relevant to the conversation while preserving markdown links.

The project gallery now groups AI-assisted coding and website-building projects under Vibe Coding ✨, removes duplicate listings from other categories, and includes the category in featured-project selection.

The project lists now include MoneyPrinterTurbo, which uses Pollinations text generation for short-video scripts, and Imagemate AI, an Android app that generates images from text prompts.

highlights.title: Generated images for ads
highlights.text: Ads triggered by `p-ads` can pair a generated 120×120 image with concise copy shaped by the recent conversation. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
